title: Interactions » Member Leads
text:
## Interactions » Member Leads
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000094617

## Member Leads Module
The member leads module provides a great user experience, making it easy to manage incoming leads submitted by website users.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127827995/original/g0YuOcfK67519hZ24apUmqZ_Y7qqq8CWbg.png?1688442976 | alt: ]

## Leads Module
To open the Lead Module, navigate to:
Interactions
Member Leads
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127828694/original/K9EqRUi515aSTPlhI06ZqOcIAzb02fTwNQ.png?1688444480 | alt: ]

## Leads Module Settings
Lead ID: This is the unique ID of the lead.
Actions Dropdown (Explained Below) .
Submitted: Date and time in which the lead was submitted.
IP Address of the lead submitter. It can be blocked if it ends up being a SPAM submission.
Accepted: Number of times the lead has been accepted.
Total Matches: The number of times the lead has been matched
Total Revenue: Total amount of revenue generated by this lead.
Lead Status (Pending, Follow-up, Matched, Sold Out, Closed, Bad Leads, Delete).
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12143194569/original/VuzCWyjHHmvgqP1YAZXpmIVYv8tc4Iv-Ew.png?1715636178 | alt: ]
Pending - The lead has been submitted but it has not been matched with any of the website members that can receive leads.
Follow Up - * Requires additional follow up.
Matched - The lead has been matched to members and hasn't been accepted/paid by a member yet.
Sold Out - The lead has been sold.
Closed - Lead has been accepted and no more actions are required.
Bad Leads - * Could be a spam or accidental lead.
Delete - * Lead needs to be deleted.
* Denotes an internal status for admin purposes only

## Actions Dropdown:
Match Lead: Here's the option to see more details of leads and manually match them to members.
Edit Lead: This option allows directory owners to control what information is submitted with the lead.
Email Submitter: This option allows sending an email to the user who submitted the lead.
Delete: One can quickly delete any undesired lead on the website.

## Lead Information
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127828704/original/Bic85KmPB_nEqQVAYVq6CBqHaJPS0VcvQA.png?1688444522 | alt: ]
The information submitted on the Lead will be visible under lead information and the option for the admin to leave notes:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12163663694/original/zWiJe7DPEahkPwmgVby2NqvjlH3PODzJUg.png?1751386334 | alt: ]
Origin page: This will show the link from the page the lead was submitted from.
Name: Submitter's name.
Email: Submitter's email.
Phone Number: Submitter's number.
Preferred Reply Time and Date: When the lead submitter prefers to be contacted.
Location: Submitter's location.
S elect an Option: Top category selected by the submitter.
Message: Lead message entered by submitter.
Internal Note To Member: As an admin, there is an option to add a note for the member regarding the specific lead.
NOTE: This information may vary based on the fields of the Get Matched Form.
If the lead was created via API using Zapier , the origin text will display the following message: "Received From External Source". This text can be edited under Settings » Text Labels .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12163785898/original/uCqGd8abbq5ZnmOQFlhtVlEv4FDeRa5ZaQ.jpeg?1751554473 | alt: ]

## Filter Options
The information can be filtered by:
Keyword / Lead ID
Date Range
Submitter's Email
Lead Status
Top Category
Sub Category
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127828023/original/FIKUEdg3AvPpiJSSGguVxKV4oyUiy1EJkA.png?1688443123 | alt: ]
The option to select all leads and bulk change their status is also possible:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128905638/original/MsnJI5ljD0yYyjsEz1TCWKOg5SebdbLIfw.png?1690320672 | alt: ]
